card.name: Linking words before clotting-reversal agents
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with", "of", "or" and commas just before a named agent, such as prothrombin complex concentrate, recombinant factor VIIa, vitamin K or protamine, or a condition such as mononucleosis. Seen in bleeding and hemostasis drug-label text.
